_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING for CableControl, each with the proof behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file, and a declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR -- every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. FOUR are declared here and THREE SURVIVORS ARE NOT: the score is 0.9647 and not 1.000, which is the point. All four are EQUIVALENCES PROVED OVER THE WHOLE INPUT STRUCTURE -- none is the weaker `unreachable-with-a-measurement` claim, and the three survivors that WOULD have qualified for that weaker claim are deliberately left standing instead, each with the input that would kill it and the count showing the corpus does not hold it, in evidence/CableControl/errmsg_census.txt. The undeclared parts are committed beside this file (the first-take parts in evidence/CableControl/mutation.first_take.*.json carry `equivalent_declared: 0`) so that what survived is on the record before any of it was excused.
c478b82f: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `const std::string_view v(ErrVar->ErrMsg, n > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(n) : 0);` in `errmsg_trim`. EQUIVALENT ON EVERY VALUE OF THE TYPE, and the proof is two lines rather than a sweep: the two conditions differ at exactly one value, `n == 0`, and there the tight form takes `: 0` and yields 0 while the loose form takes `static_cast<size_t>(0)` and yields 0. Same length, same view, same string. For every other n the conditions agree, so no input of any kind distinguishes them. FOURTH UNIT AT THIS SITE, in the same copied helper and with the same reason: interp1d's b61327db was declared against an exhaustive sweep of all 4,294,967,296 int values reporting 0 differences (evidence/interp1d/equivalence_probe.txt), interp2d's f0949202 and AeroDynTorque's 04ed59c3 state the reason that sweep found nothing. NOT REMOVED: a negative length is the view's NOT-ALLOCATED convention and the guard is what collapses it to the empty string rather than to a 4-billion-byte view.
3e8f1ad8: const_tweak '1' -> '2' at `LocalVar->restart ? 1 : 0` in the `seclpfilter_vel_c` call -- the callee's `reset` argument. EQUIVALENT BECAUSE THE CALLEE'S OWN BOUNDARY DISCARDS EVERY NON-ZERO VALUE, and the boundary was READ rather than assumed. `translations/Controllers/cablecontrol_test/cablecontrol_callees.f90:67-69`, the bridge `vit test-validate` generated for this comparison, passes `(reset /= 0)` to the Fortran `SecLPFilter_Vel`, whose dummy is `LOGICAL(4), INTENT(IN) :: reset`. 1 and 2 are both `.TRUE.` and 0 is `.FALSE.`, so the three-valued C expression collapses to the two-valued Fortran one before the callee sees it. THE SAME HOLDS AFTER INTEGRATION, which is the configuration this declaration also has to survive: there `seclpfilter_vel_c` is unit #19's C++ body, whose first use of the parameter is `if ((iStatus == 0) || (reset != 0))` (translations/Filters/seclpfilter_vel.cpp:38) -- the same `/= 0` test one language over. NOT REWRITTEN to `!!LocalVar->restart`: the `? 1 : 0` spelling is what the generated Fortran wrapper writes at the integrated call site (`MERGE(1_C_INT, 0_C_INT, restart)`), and matching it is what makes the two sides visibly one convention.
d54225a5: const_tweak '0.0' -> '1.0' at `&objInst->instSecLPFV, 0, 0.0);` -- the OPTIONAL `InitialValue` argument of `seclpfilter_vel_c`, whose presence flag is the literal `0` beside it. EQUIVALENT BECAUSE THE ARGUMENT IS NEVER PASSED ON. `cablecontrol_callees.f90:66-69` is `IF (has_InitialValue /= 0) THEN <call WITH InitialValue> ELSE <call WITHOUT it> ENDIF`, so with the flag at 0 the value slot is read by nothing: the Fortran `SecLPFilter_Vel` sees `PRESENT(InitialValue) == .FALSE.` and sets `InitialValue_ = InputSignal`. AFTER INTEGRATION the same holds through the other implementation: unit #19's C++ body is `double InitialValue_ = InputSignal; if (has_InitialValue) InitialValue_ = InitialValue;` (translations/Filters/seclpfilter_vel.cpp:32-33). THE FLAG ITSELF IS NOT DECLARED -- the sibling mutant that moves that `0` to `1` is KILLED, which is the control that this pair of arguments is not simply invisible. NOT REMOVED: the reference's call site omits an OPTIONAL argument and the bridge's two-argument convention is how that crosses C; a translation that dropped the pair could not express the omission.
049cd9a7: const_tweak '1' -> '2' at `LocalVar->restart ? 1 : 0` in the `picontroller_c` call -- the callee's `reset` argument. The same proof as 3e8f1ad8 one call down: `cablecontrol_callees.f90:94` passes `(reset /= 0)` to a `LOGICAL(4), INTENT(IN) :: reset` dummy, and after integration unit #33's C++ body tests `if (reset != 0)` (translations/Controllers/picontroller.cpp:30). Declared as a separate entry rather than folded into 3e8f1ad8 because they are two sites and a reader checking one should not have to infer the other.
